line: A cat photo hops across app cards on a sunlit desk, from one phone to a friend's.
line_cn: 一张猫照片跳过桌上的应用卡片，从一台手机飞到朋友手机里，一镜跟到底。

motion.cuts: one-take UI flythrough or snap zoom

camera.move: Macro glide with a slow orbit (close, 20–45° down)
camera.serves: a character at work; one detail of an interface; a title standing on the desk

camera.move: Whip from card to card (0.3–0.5 s, banking into the turn)
camera.serves: a process moving on; a hand-off between tools

camera.expresses: reading, one card as a whole
camera.serves: a screen, a counter, a table; any verdict

camera.move: Ride along, low behind the subject
camera.serves: a route; a delivery; a download
a recap; the route so far; many stations at once
a press, a stamp, a ring

transitions: One take, no cuts, no dissolves.
labels: In the world, only keywords and numbers: step badges (a camera-facing accent pill with a digit and one word), sizes, a name on a screen, a banner, a title card. Text meant to be read is framed above the subtitle area, held still for its reading time, and large enough at the angle it is seen: flat print reads from 55–70° down; a low camera reads a standing tent card.

Titles are objects on the desk: an opening tent card beside the first stop; at the end a large paper card dropped onto open desk in the final frame. Where depends on the layout: wherever it covers no station, route or character and sits clear of the subtitle bar (the demo's stops leave the middle free; a zigzag layout may leave the front edge). Leave that space when laying out the desk.
Every face on screen comes from the film's own font files (cards, pills, subtitles); the mono stack falls back to the film's CJK face, never to a system face.

Three roles: a mono for labels and numbers (spaced caps), a sans with a heavy weight for pills, titles and subtitles, and a CJK (or other script) face both fall back to. The families are free (e.g. DM Mono or JetBrains Mono, Manrope or Space Grotesk, the Noto Sans of the film's language); the roles are not. Pixels belong to the cast, so no pixel font on the print.
motion: 30 fps. One steady tempo (110–130 BPM); every action on the 16th grid, big moments on downbeats.

Hops: an arc with squash and stretch (stretch about 14 % in the air, squash about 30 % for 0.2 s on landing, a small anticipation squash before take-off). Groups move follow-the-leader, each a 16th behind the one ahead, so they never close up.
Characters act: they blink every couple of seconds, bounce on the beat while they wait, squint when they are squashed, lean towards what they look at.

Pop: sticker → toy in 0.25–0.5 s (hinge up with overshoot, cells extrude from the centre, a small jump, squash on landing). Reverse pop: toy → sticker or print when it is stored, delivered or taped down.

native_moves.name: Sticker pop
native_moves.does: A flat pixel sticker on a card stands up and extrudes into a toy on a 16th.
native_moves.fits: a new user, file or job appearing; a feature switched on; an order placed.

native_moves.name: Reverse pop
native_moves.does: A toy lies back down into a sticker or a print.
native_moves.fits: a photo delivered into a chat; a snapshot saved; a task archived.

native_moves.name: Press
native_moves.does: A heavy plate drops on a toy; pixel debris bursts out and rolls away; the same character pops out at half resolution beside a counter that runs down.
native_moves.fits: compression; a budget cut; a summary of a long report.

native_moves.name: Drawer
native_moves.does: A slab of a stacked tower slides open, a toy hops in, it closes and one window lights; small data cubes hop into the windows.
native_moves.fits: storing something in the cloud; a queue; an archive.

native_moves.name: Messenger
native_moves.does: A small voxel object (a bell, an envelope) flies an arc between two cards leaving a dotted trail, taps the target twice, and a banner drops on its screen.
native_moves.fits: a notification; a hand-off; an alert.

native_moves.name: Data run
native_moves.does: A stream of small bright cubes runs along the route between two stations.
native_moves.fits: a download; a sync; a payment going through.

native_moves.name: Blurry, then sharp
native_moves.does: A picture on a screen card is printed blurred, then snaps sharp as the toy lands in it.
native_moves.fits: loading; focus; a draft becoming final.

native_moves.name: UI rises
native_moves.does: Part of the printed interface grows into 3D out of its printed shape.
native_moves.fits: progress; a metric climbing; a step badge.

native_moves.name: Curtain call
native_moves.does: The closing pull-back frames every stop; each hops once, left to right, the characters pop back up, and a title card drops into open space.
native_moves.fits: a recap; a team; a pipeline shown whole.

score.note: bright and warm: marimba, vibraphone, plucked bass, soft synth kick, claps
